params.batchSizeHint: Number of rows inserted per transaction. Smaller values reduce timeout risk on large tables. Default is 10,000.

params.validationHint: Adds a SELECT COUNT(*) at the end to verify that the number of migrated rows matches the origin.

tips.backup: Make a backup of the destination database before running the migration.
